polymarket.title: Will Bitcoin reach $100,000 by December 31, 2026?
polymarket.description: This market resolves YES if the price of Bitcoin (BTC) reaches or exceeds $100,000 USD on any major exchange at any point before the resolution date.
polymarket.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Coinbase BTC-USD spot trades at or above $100,000 at any time on or before 2026-12-31 23:59 ET.

kalshi.title: Bitcoin above $100,000 on Dec 31, 2026?
kalshi.resolution_criteria: Settles YES if the CF Benchmarks Bitcoin Real Time Index (BRTI) is at or above $100,000 at 2026-12-31 17:00 ET.

adjudication.rationale: Same underlying event: BTC at/above $100k by 2026-12-31. Titles and resolution dates align; resolution criteria differ only in price oracle (Coinbase spot vs CF Benchmarks BRTI), immaterial for the same threshold and date.

polymarket.title: Will the Republican Party win a majority in the U.S. House in the 2026 elections?
polymarket.description: Resolves YES if the Republican Party holds at least 218 seats in the U.S. House of Representatives following the November 2026 general election.
polymarket.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if Republicans are projected by the Associated Press to control at least 218 House seats after the 2026 general election.

kalshi.title: Will the GOP control the House after the 2026 midterms?
kalshi.resolution_criteria: Settles YES if the Republican Party holds 218 or more seats in the U.S. House of Representatives for the Congress seated in January 2027.

adjudication.rationale: Paraphrase of the same event: 'Republican Party win majority' vs 'GOP control the House'. Surface tokens differ (GOP vs Republican Party, midterms vs elections) but category, date, and the 218-seat resolution criteria are identical.

polymarket.title: Will the Fed cut interest rates at the July 2026 FOMC meeting?
polymarket.description: Resolves YES if the Federal Open Market Committee lowers the federal funds target range at its scheduled July 2026 meeting.
polymarket.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the upper bound of the federal funds target range announced at the July 2026 FOMC meeting is lower than the prior range.

kalshi.title: Fed decreases rates at the July 2026 meeting?
kalshi.resolution_criteria: Settles YES if the FOMC reduces the target federal funds rate at its July 2026 meeting per the official statement.

adjudication.rationale: Same event: a Fed rate cut at the July 2026 FOMC meeting. Category, date, and resolution criteria match; 'cut' vs 'decreases' is a synonym.

polymarket.title: Will Polkadot launch its DOT 2.0 mainnet upgrade in 2026?
polymarket.description: Resolves YES if the Polkadot network activates the DOT 2.0 (Polkadot 2.0) protocol upgrade on mainnet during 2026.
polymarket.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Polkadot 2.0 upgrade is activated on the Polkadot mainnet on or before 2026-12-31, per the official Polkadot release notes.

kalshi.title: Will Polkadot (DOT) trade above $20 on Dec 31, 2026?
kalshi.resolution_criteria: Settles YES if the DOT-USD price is at or above $20.00 at 2026-12-31 17:00 ET per the reference index.

adjudication.rationale: Shares the rare token 'Polkadot/DOT' and the same resolution date, but these are different events: a protocol mainnet upgrade vs a spot price threshold. A single shared rare term must not drive a match.

polymarket.title: Will Tesla stock close above $400 at the end of 2026?
polymarket.description: Resolves YES if Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) common stock closes at or above $400.00 on the last trading day of 2026.
polymarket.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the TSLA closing price on the final Nasdaq trading day of 2026 is at or above $400.00.

kalshi.title: Will Tesla deliver more than 2.5 million vehicles in 2026?
kalshi.resolution_criteria: Settles YES if Tesla's officially reported full-year 2026 vehicle deliveries exceed 2,500,000 units.

adjudication.rationale: Near-miss: both mention 'Tesla' and '2026' so titles look similar, but they are different events (stock price vs vehicle deliveries) in different categories (economics vs tech) with different resolution dates. The category gate should reject this.

polymarket.title: Will the Kansas City Chiefs win Super Bowl LXI?
polymarket.description: Resolves YES if the Kansas City Chiefs win Super Bowl LXI (the championship game of the 2026 NFL season).
polymarket.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Kansas City Chiefs are the winning team of Super Bowl LXI.

kalshi.title: Will the Kansas City Chiefs make the 2026 NFL playoffs?
kalshi.resolution_criteria: Settles YES if the Kansas City Chiefs qualify for the 2026-27 NFL playoffs.

adjudication.rationale: Same team, same category, and overlapping tokens ('Kansas City Chiefs', 'NFL'), but different events: winning the Super Bowl vs merely making the playoffs. Distinct resolution criteria and dates.

polymarket.title: Will the U.S. enter a recession in 2026?
polymarket.description: Resolves YES if the United States enters a recession during the 2026 calendar year.
polymarket.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) declares a recession with a peak dated within 2026.

kalshi.title: Will U.S. real GDP shrink in two consecutive quarters in 2026?
kalshi.resolution_criteria: Settles YES if the BEA reports two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP growth with both quarters falling in 2026.

adjudication.rationale: Same category and topic (US recession in 2026), but materially different resolution definitions: NBER's declaration vs the technical two-consecutive-negative-quarters rule. These can diverge in both outcome and timing. After checking titles, dates, and criteria it remains unclear whether these are the same event for arbitrage purposes.

polymarket.title: Will 2026 be the hottest year on record globally?
polymarket.description: Resolves YES if 2026 is the warmest year in the global surface temperature record.
polymarket.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if NASA GISS reports 2026 as the highest global mean surface temperature anomaly on record.

kalshi.title: Will 2026 set a new global average temperature record?
kalshi.resolution_criteria: Settles YES if NOAA reports 2026 as the warmest year in the global average temperature record.

adjudication.rationale: Same event paraphrased: 'hottest year on record' vs 'new global average temperature record' for 2026. Same category and date; resolution criteria differ only in dataset provider (NASA GISS vs NOAA), which track closely for record-year determinations.
